questions.cardText:
[History] What is the song “Bella Ciao” about?
A. It is an anti-fascist resistance song
B. It is an Italian love ballad
C. It is a celebration song for harvest
Answer: A. “Bella Ciao” was one of the songs sung by the Italian anti-fascist resistance movement during WWII. It likely emerged from a blend and reworking of various traditional songs from central and northern Italy and southern France.
questions.de: Zur Hymne welcher antifaschistischen Bewegung wurde das italienische Volkslied „Bella ciao“?
questions.en: The Italian folk song “Bella ciao” became the anthem of which anti-fascist movement?

timeline.labelEn: The Italian resistance fights German occupiers and fascist forces
timeline.labelDe: Die italienische Resistenza kämpft gegen deutsche Besatzer und faschistische Truppen

questions.notes: Card overstates: Wikipedia notes little evidence the song was sung during WWII; the partisan version became widespread only after the war. Its origins are unclear (one theory: a late-19th-century song of Po Valley rice weeders).

questions.cardText:
[Chemistry] Which one of the following is organic?
A. Nitrate B. Methane C. Iron oxide
Answer: B. Organic compounds are primarily made of carbon atoms bonded with hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, or other elements. Methane is a simple organic molecule consisting of one carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms.
questions.de: Wie heißt die einfache organische Verbindung aus einem Kohlenstoffatom, an das vier Wasserstoffatome gebunden sind (CH4)?
questions.en: What is the name of the simple organic compound made of one carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms (CH4)?

timeline.labelEn: Alessandro Volta collects marsh gas at Lake Maggiore and identifies methane as a flammable gas
timeline.labelDe: Alessandro Volta sammelt am Lago Maggiore Sumpfgas und erkennt Methan als brennbares Gas

questions.notes: 'Which of the following is organic' only works among the options; asked the underlying fact from the explanation. Card correct.
